description: This file provides utility functions related to streak calculation and date checks for a habit tracking application. It includes functions to check if a date is within a list, determine vacation days, and compute current and longest streaks considering vacation days.

methods.name: isDateIn(dateISO, list)
methods.description: Checks whether a specified ISO date exists in a provided list of dates.

methods.name: calculateStreak(habit, settings, dateISO, completedToday = true)
methods.description: Calculates the current streak and longest streak for a habit, considering vacation days and last check-in date.

ctags.name: calculateStreak
ctags.pattern: /^export function calculateStreak(habit, settings, dateISO, completedToday = true) {$/
